column1: # Arabic pack (ar, Modern Standard Arabic), phase 1 (2026-10-22). Readings carry no short vowels.
# Keys of `number`: a final m/f is the gender of the counted noun (3m ثلاثة رجال, 3f ثلاث سيارات);
# o is the oblique case (اثنين, عشرين), c the construct form before a noun (مئتي, ألفي).
# ordinals (oblique in compounds: الحادي والعشرين), masculine and feminine
# Gregorian months (the Egyptian and Gulf names) and Hijri months
# Latin letter names in Arabic script
# the pack readings win over the shared grammar on the same extent (2026-10-22)
